claim_one_line: THE PAPER-SPINE SWEEP (the owner's question -- does the P3 spec reflect the current state to the last bit? -- answered by MEASUREMENT rather than assertion: IT DID NOT). THE COVERAGE GAP: the spec, drafted from the thesis as this seat holds it, cites 11 OF THE 85 ARCS banked in its own last ten days and 1 OF THE CORPUS'S 48 LAW-CREATING ARCS -- a spine assembled from memory reproduces the memory, not the record, which is the inverse of the accretion hazard the spec itself had warned about for THE_SM_VERDICT one day earlier. THE INSTRUMENT AND ITS OWN MID-RUN CORRECTION: spine_sweep.py builds the pool mechanically (law-creating arcs + the registered synthesis surfaces = 442) and hunts supersession; the FIRST PASS matched verbs anywhere in an arc's claim and flagged 229 pool arcs and 15 of the spec's 24 citations as extended/corrected/withdrawn -- MOSTLY NOISE, killed by spot-checking the two most alarming (B1159 was read as WITHDRAWING B727 when it CITES its genericity; B978 as withdrawing B862/B864 when it is the arc that CONFIRMS them, recording that B950/B976 wrongly declared them absent). An arc claim is ONE LONG SENTENCE ABOUT MANY THINGS, so claim-scope matching applies every verb to every reference; rescoped to CLAUSE SCOPE (verb within 90 chars) the numbers fall to 79 and 5 of 24, and the reportable number is the second. TWO FINDINGS THAT CHANGE THE PAPER: (a) the Z6 derivation was cited on the WEAKER of two footings -- B862 is 'conditional on exactly what the cascade is conditional on' while B1080 (later, law-creating) confirms it INDEPENDENTLY AND EXTENDS it, Z/6 uniform over six Weyl realizations with row 1's full algebra giving Z/6 x Z/2; both are now cited. (b) THE ONE THAT MATTERS -- the spec listed the cascade's landing on su(3)+su(2)+u(1)^3 among the FORCED results, and B951 DEFLATES EXACTLY THAT HEADLINE: the landing is precisely the A2+A1 LEVI SUBALGEBRA of e6 (dim 6+8=14, semisimple part 11, centre 6-3=3 -- 'WHICH ARE EXACTLY B892's THREE NUMBERS') and arriving there from E6 is BOREL-DE SIEBENTHAL 1949 / DYNKIN 1952, classical. IT MOVES FROM THE FORCED LIST TO THE RECOGNITION TABLE: what survives as forced is the chain's TERMINATION and the GLOBAL FORM, not the ARRIVAL -- with B953's sharpening (skipping SU(5) is skipping the rank reduction; the two unsheddable units are U(1)_psi and U(1)_chi) as a second recognition row. This is precisely the correction a referee would have made, on the paper's most exposed claim, in the genre where that exposure is fatal. PRODUCED: papers/P3_THE_PAPER/CLAIM_CANDIDATES.md (all 48 law-creating arcs grouped by the section they would serve, supersession flags attached, disposition column left EMPTY because it is an editorial call) -- and its distribution is itself a finding, 20 of 48 landing in the OBSERVER section, where the paper's weight genuinely sits. FENCES: the pool is complete for its criterion and that criterion is not 'everything the paper might cite' (coverage of the remaining ~660 PROVED arcs is NOT claimed); the detector reports LEXICAL relations, so five flags means five pairs TO READ, not five corrections established -- three of the five are confirmations on their face.
